race.comment: CARDONETTE (7) justified the very short quote fresh when lengthening stylishly down the outside at the Gold Coast. Drawn sticky but get a key switch in Thompson, who's 3/3 in the placings when partnering. Ready to convert one of them to a win. CONFORMITY (9) poses a genuine threat fresh after a promising debut prep. Her recent trial win suggests she's come back in great order, though the wide draw could see her get a long way back. DUKE OF ALBEMARLE (10) boasts strong juvenile form, including a Doomben placing in 2YO Open company and experience in the G3 Ken Russell Memorial Classic. Query his fitness though with just one quiet trial under his belt. DRINKWATER (6) won maiden at the Gold Coast convincingly and retains Daniel Moor. Needs to go up a rung but should improve.
